# Branch library opening hours — 2026-10-09

**Participants:** Moira Easterbrook (Branch Manager), Teo Lindahl (Librarian)

Moira: "We open at eight on Tuesdays and Thursdays so the commuter crowd can return books on the way in."

Teo: "And we close an hour earlier those days to keep the staffing flat."

segments.exact: We open at eight on Tuesdays and Thursdays so the commuter crowd can return books on the way in.
And we close an hour earlier those days to keep the staffing flat.

observations.why: Frames schedule adjustment as a zero-sum balancing mechanism (opening earlier balanced by closing earlier to maintain an even staffing baseline).
